title: Add missing validations to Test-TaskRecords.ps1
description: Test-TaskRecords.ps1 validates JSON, id/key format, statuses, and duplicate detection but is missing: priority whitelist check (only Critical/High/Medium/Low allowed), required field presence check (createdAtUtc, updatedAtUtc, revision), camelCase field casing validation, and prohibited label prefix check (no p0/p1/P0 labels). Also add post-import validation to Import-OpenTasksFromWorkbench.ps1. See AGENTS.md for full schema contract requirements. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-035
